name: writing-loop
description: An autonomous short-drama (竖屏短剧) writers' room in a folder. Nine agents plan, design, write, review, score, and market-watch scripts through ticket state on a local board. A North Star creative charter plus two canonical structured JSON documents hold season design, characters, world facts, continuity, foreshadowing, and dual-order timelines without duplicate Markdown mirrors. A 4-dimension/16-indicator rubric gates milestones. Supports autonomous novel-adaptation intake and original creation. Operator skill: add-script.
